summary:
Claim for flight AF6 on 2026-10-12 (CDG→JFK).
Result: ELIGIBLE for EUR 300.
Why: Covered: the flight departed from Paris, inside the EU261 area. Distance 5,834 km: EUR 600 band. Airline reason 'TECH' does not excuse the airline: technical problems are part of normal airline operations (CJEU C-549/07). The flight arrived 3 h 20 min late (3 h or more). Long flight delayed by less than 4 h: amount reduced by 50% (Art. 7(2)).
Status: waiting for human review.
Next step: A claims handler must approve the drafted letter before it is sent.

letter.subject: EU261 compensation claim - flight AF6 on 2026-10-12
letter.body:
Dear Air France Customer Relations,

We act on behalf of our client regarding flight AF6 on 2026-10-12 from Paris (CDG) to New York (JFK), which was delayed, arriving 3 hours and 20 minutes late.

Under Regulation (EC) No 261/2004, Articles 5, 7 and the case law of the Court of Justice of the EU, the passenger is entitled to compensation of EUR 300 for this long delay. The flight distance is 5,834 km.

Based on the information available to us, no extraordinary circumstances apply.

Please pay EUR 300 within 14 days of this letter and send your reply to our claims team.

Yours faithfully,
Claims Team
